recap.text: Britney and Vadim join Carl's team. Katia tells Carl that pregnant women cannot enter the dungeon and nobody inside can get pregnant. Britney enters the dungeon off a flying house with a cat. Vadim dies after he ignores Britney's warning not to go down.

Britney is a Pit Champion and guitarist who joins Donut as a plus-one to avoid Gideon's assault team. She uses a stuffed slate butterfly to disable a warning light and plays a missing-string guitar for Donut and Tina. After her jacket of butterflies absorbs a bolt of lightning from the queen, Britney is badly burned in the face.

Britney cries and holds Louis while Katia worries about their grief over Firas. Britney has a burn on her face that heals shiny and uneven. Donut says the scar fits a barbarian look. Britney reaches level 55 and gets an extinction sigil tattoo under her eye for wiping out an entire race.

Britney acts as the liaison to the NPCs because Carl cannot reach their spies. Carl communicates through Britney to Juice Box or Arief. Naga ground prevents the use of big diggers, so two changeling spies wait in place.

Britney leaves the Desperado Club with a drink and tells Carl to survive. She kills Osvaldo at the portals and takes Ysalte's memorial crystal. Britney enters a portal behind Chris, causing the croupier to shout cheat. She tells Louis to let a leech filter his blood and tells others not to hurt Chris.

beats.headline: Two new crawlers
beats.text: Vadim and I have fallen in with Carl's team. Introductions here are short. Everyone counts heads, adds two, moves on. The first real conversation I hear is Katia telling Carl that pregnant women could not enter the dungeon, and that nobody inside it can get pregnant. Said flat. Like weather. That is the kind of thing people know here, and say out loud. I am going to have to get used to that.
beats.gist: Britney Proskurina and Vadim join Carl's team, and Katia tells Carl pregnant women cannot enter.

beats.headline: He went anyway
beats.text: I came in with the cat, off the flying house. I'm in the corner where the crafting room meets the back wall. Vadim is dead. I told him not to go. Everybody who goes down there dies; I said it at the table, in front of all of them. He said he'd go. He said it twice. He went.
beats.gist: Britney entered with the cat off the flying house and stays in the crafting room corner.

beats.headline: Mongo's spot
beats.text: I'm in Mongo's spot on the floor. I push him away a few times. He puts his head in my lap anyway, and now I am petting him like a dog. I was a Pit Fighter. I'm a Pit Champion now. Carl doesn't know what's different and I don't tell him. I am not Firas's girlfriend. Then Donut says pet beauty contest and the dinosaur jumps up and starts hopping, and I shriek and get out from under him.
beats.gist: Britney pets Mongo like a dog in his spot on the floor.

beats.headline: Zapped out on an empty bar
beats.text: Zapped away by the new rules. Blood bar empty. I'm outside now, not too far off. I haven't killed a thing this whole floor, and Katia hadn't noticed. Her group is coming for me on the way to the southeast corner.
beats.gist: Britney zaps out on an empty blood bar and Katia's group comes for her.

beats.headline: Donut's guitarist
beats.text: I'm not top fifty. Firas talked me into this: Donut's plus-one, because I play guitar. It was this or Gideon's assault team. The jacket itches. The elf says security checks, twice, and those are just the ones he's telling us about. This isn't going to work. I've been taking the dinosaur repellant every day. Mongo still tackles me. Shield's ready. Then the queen fades in next to me, and I cast it.
beats.gist: Britney plays guitar as Donut's plus-one and takes dinosaur repellant, but Mongo still tackles her.

beats.headline: The queen lowers her hand
beats.text: I'm in the carriage with Carl when the queen appears. A notification comes in: an achievement for total views, a fan box. Carl and I look at each other. The queen turns to me and lifts her hand as if to cast. Then she stops. When she's gone I tell Carl she reminds me of my mother.
beats.gist: Britney and Carl receive a fan box for total views before the queen reminds Britney of her mother.

beats.headline: The butterfly on the warning light
beats.text: My part is the light. I sidle up to the guard with the giant spear, say something, giggle. I drop something, and when he looks down I pull a tag on my jacket. One stuffed slate butterfly comes alive, flies straight to the warning light and wraps it in its wings until the glow fades. It turns back into a toy, falls, hits the tip of his spear and lands in my hand. He never looks up in time. Carl says good job. I'm not doing that again.
beats.gist: Britney uses a stuffed slate butterfly to hide a warning light while a guard holds a spear.

beats.headline: The guitar with a missing string
beats.text: Backstage, I play. It's the Popovs' guitar, found in a boss room a long time ago, and it's missing a string. A sad minor strum for Donut's song, and it sounds full anyway. When she's done I let the last chord hang and go into something fast and baroque for Tina. Carl tells me I need to get away from the backstage area and come out. I let the guitar fade.
beats.gist: Britney plays a stringless Popov guitar for Donut and Tina before Carl tells her to leave.

beats.headline: The jacket takes the lightning
beats.text: I'm on the ground, screaming. Carl throws a disco ball at the queen and shouts at me: your jacket! The butterflies spread, and the queen's lightning comes out as one bolt instead of everywhere, pulled into the clump of them. They explode barely ten feet over our heads. Donut and Mongo and Carl and I go flying in different directions.
beats.gist: Carl throws a disco ball at the queen and shouts for Britney to use her jacket.

beats.headline: Badly burned
beats.text: Morning, if you can call it that. Donut is waking Carl up with the count from the night. Firas. The Popovs. I'm not on the list, so that's something. My face is. Nobody has offered me a mirror, and nobody offering is how I know how bad it is. Burned. Badly, I'm told. I can feel where the word comes from.
beats.gist: Donut wakes Carl with the night's count. Britney is not on the list, but her face is burned.

beats.headline: The burn stays
beats.text: Katia's squad, Iceland. The burn on my face still hasn't healed. Neither Louis nor I have opened our boxes. I sit and hold on to Louis, and I don't stop crying. We are both still broken up about Firas. Katia is worried. She has asked Imani to come over and talk to me.
beats.gist: Britney and Louis have not opened their boxes and cry over Firas in Iceland.

beats.headline: Scarred, and level fifty-five
beats.text: Donut tells me it is not so bad. The whole left side of my face is burn scar from the end of the last floor, healed shiny and uneven. She says scars are beautiful and go with the barbarian look I am going for. I am not worried about it anymore. I have been talking to Tserendolgor, who once had a scar like this on her face. I am level 55 now. There is a new tattoo under my eye, an extinction sigil. I wiped out an entire race.
beats.gist: Britney is level 55 with an extinction sigil tattoo and burn scars on her left face.

beats.headline: Liaison to the NPCs
beats.text: Somehow I'm the one who talks to the NPCs now. Carl can't reach their spies himself, so it goes him, then me, then Juice Box or Arief. The plan wanted one of their big diggers. Naga ground won't allow it, so it's two changeling spies instead. Carl asks if my guys are in place. They're ready. Waiting on you.
beats.gist: Britney acts as liaison to NPCs for Carl, communicating with Juice Box or Arief.

beats.headline: Don't worry about me, Carl
beats.text: Elle wants us to run. Louis won't, and I won't, and she kept pushing, so I walked out. Now I'm coming out of the Desperado Club with a drink and running straight into Carl and the cat. I tell them I have to get back to Louis. We're switching to the gecko because it can fly. Carl grabs my arm and asks if I'm okay. I put my hand on his chest and say it without saying it out loud. Don't worry about me. You just need to survive.
beats.gist: Britney leaves the Desperado Club with a drink and tells Carl and the cat she must return.

beats.headline: She kills Osvaldo at the portals
beats.text: Crawler Osvaldo made a run for the portals to the eleventh floor across a roof Crawler Carl had just blown open. He did not reach them. Crawler Britney stopped him, permanently, and took Ysalte's memorial crystal off what remained. One crawler ran. One did not let him. The crystal changed hands. I am not required to have an opinion, but I have watched a great many exits, and that one was clean.
beats.gist: Britney kills Osvaldo at the portals and takes Ysalte's memorial crystal from him.

beats.headline: Through the portal behind Chris
beats.text: The croupier sets the wheel and the portal opens under the stand-here spot. One person, they said. A test. Chris steps up, turns, waves, and drops. I go straight in after him without a word. Nobody planned that and I didn't ask. The croupier shouts cheat, and Carl has the goat pay him another five thousand. Louis gets a notice that I've left the party. That's all there is to say about it.
beats.gist: Britney enters a portal after Chris, causing the croupier to shout cheat.

beats.headline: A leech for Louis
beats.text: Louis comes out of the fold coughing steam through his gills. I tell him to let Forkith work, or he dies. The leech filters your blood so you live down here. Chris got changed by the first Scolopendra attack. Werewolf. A Crest knocks him out before he turns, and somebody says they don't know him from the feeds. I tell them who he is. I tell them not to hurt him.
beats.gist: Louis coughs steam through his gills; Britney tells him to let Forkith work or he dies.
